0022600018.text: The 76ers (4-1, first in the Atlantic and second in the East, on a one-game win streak) host the Knicks (2-3, fourth in the Atlantic and eighth in the East, on a two-game win streak) in the sixth game of Philadelphia's season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness), Jaylen Brown (knee), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), while New York is missing Jose Alvarado (ankle, sprain) and has Karl-Anthony Towns listed as day-to-day. The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 106-100 win in New York on October 20, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26 before Philadelphia was swept 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs.
